title: Gravestone Obituaries 2 MC Paper
description: This Datapack adds a Crafting recipe to turn Obituaries from The Gravestone Mod into basic Minecraft Paper
body:
This Datapack adds a Crafting recipe to turn Obituaries from the Gravestone mod into basic Minecraft Paper.

This Datapack currently only works for 1.20 and 1.20.1,

If you need a different version feel free to go into the code to change 1 number. [How to do that (look for "Data pack formats")](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorials/Creating_a_data_pack#Pack_format)
